description: Find real products in VoltPlan's curated component catalogue that match a spec, e.g. a 200 Ah 12 V LiFePO4 battery or a 2000 W pure-sine inverter. Results come closest rating first. The catalogue is small and curated, so results may deviate from the requested spec; check the listed specs. Use it after the calculators (calculate_battery_bank, calculate_solar_size, calculate_inverter_size) have sized the part. Returns product pages and buy links for each product; show them to the user.

capacityAh.description: Batteries only: target capacity in amp-hours. Ranks results.

capacityWh.description: Batteries and power stations: target energy in watt-hours. Ranks results; for batteries capacityAh wins when both are given.

category.description: Kind of product: battery, solar_panel, solar_charge_controller (MPPT/PWM), dc_dc_charger (alternator / B2B charger), ac_charger (shore / mains battery charger), inverter (incl. inverter-chargers), power_station (portable power station), battery_monitor (shunt / battery monitor), appliance (loads such as fridges, heaters, fans)

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-10, default: 5)

powerWatts.description: Target power rating in watts: inverter continuous W, charger or controller output W, panel W, power station AC output W, appliance W. Ranks results; not used for batteries.

pureSine.description: true: only pure sine wave products (inverter, power_station).

query.description: Free-text filter; every word must appear in the product (e.g. "LiFePO4", "Victron").

systemVoltage.description: System (battery bank) voltage: 12, 24 or 48. Leaves out products built for another voltage. Ignored for solar_panel, power_station and battery_monitor.

name: find_components
title: Find Components
